title: OpenWhisker Phase 6 SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of an agent SKILL.md file. The body of the markdown file is the LLM-facing task description and is not constrained by this schema.

id.description: Globally unique skill identifier. Recommended style: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

name.description: Human-facing display name. Defaults to id when omitted.

description.description: Short purpose statement; surfaced in user-facing skill listings.

engine.description: Optional. When omitted, registry loader infers tool-calling iff vault_tools is non-empty, else static. Conflict (e.g. static + vault_tools) is rejected.

capabilities.description: Allowed capability set for this Skill. Disabled values (vault_write, arbitrary_shell, …) are rejected at registry load time.

vault_tools.description: Subset of the Phase 6 read-only tool catalog exposed to the LLM. Required and non-empty when engine=tool-calling.

vault_scope.description: Vault-relative root paths the agent may access. Each entry must fall inside VaultProfile.scheduler.read_only_vault_roots and must NOT begin with .obsidian/, .git/, .trash/, .DS_Store.

external_info_sources.description: Pre-fetched external sources injected into the initial prompt (Phase 5 compat). Subset of VaultProfile.scheduler.external_info_sources.

budget.description: Per-Skill agent runtime budget. Each value must be > 0 and not exceed the corresponding profile cap; zero/missing field falls back to profile/global default.

delivery.description: Output channels (cron-trigger only; ad-hoc paths ignore this).

skill_config.description: Free-form key/value pairs the Skill body may reference (e.g. RSS feed URLs).
